redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_run_test_gate.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 8 of 500 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - tr1 (house FAIL), tr2 (house FAIL), tr3 (house FAIL), tr4 (house FAIL), tr5 (house FAIL), tr6 (house FAIL), tr7 (house FAIL), tr8 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 492/500 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: Reviewed the applied diff against P122. The tree key is a sha1 prefix of the realpath, so it holds no path. Any other string a gate prints goes through scrubbed_ledger_row, which scrubs everything outside the project, so the tree path is covered. Fixed tr6: its probe script lived outside the repo, and the entry's path was rewritten to <outside-repo>, then --own saw a path not in tests.add. The declared tests/test_a.py is now itself the program the step runs (exit 1 in the project, 0 in the tree) and prints its own path. Documented --tree in the run-test-gate module docstring and in reference/orchestrator.md. Results: test_run_test_gate 500/500, test__verdict_binding 39/39, test__evidence_io 280/280, ruff clean, full sweep 320/320 files ok.
outcome.descriptive: run-test-gate --tree DIR measures in a task's tree and records in the project ledger with a hash-keyed tree; documented and green.
